pages.text: The pack's own tools, weapons and armour, made with Create and gated by $(l:lemursaucepacket:skills)skills$(/l). Every piece shows its stats and a "How to get" line in its tooltip, and JEI has the same "how to get" text on the item's information page (the $(#e0ac46)i$() tab next to its recipes; press R on any item).

Stats: $(bold)Damage$(), $(bold)Attack Speed$(), $(bold)Crit Chance$() (added to the Strength/Ranged crit roll), $(bold)Crit Damage$() (added to the 1.5× critical multiplier), $(bold)Defense$(), $(bold)Toughness$(), $(bold)Health$(), $(bold)Speed$(), $(bold)Luck$(). Perks are named effects a piece has on its own; a $(bold)full set$() bonus needs all four pieces; a $(bold)synergy$() is a Relics item that makes a full set stronger.

pages.text: Mining utility: light where you dig, haste when you commit to the whole set.$(br2)Wear: Mining 35.
